note: What a server sends to place a region that follows a unit, showing the map around it until it runs out or the unit is gone. A region matching one the client holds in view, sightRadius, the first three bits of does, marker, sightFrom and unit only gives that one the new lifetime.

fields.name: view
fields.note: Whose map shows the region: 0 side 100's, 1 side 200's, 2 everyone's, 3 side 300's, 4 any other. A client takes the value as it stands, so 100 or 200 here matches no one, and draws the region only where it is 2 or names the player's own side.

fields.name: unused
fields.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

fields.name: sightRadius
fields.note: How far the region shows the map around it, in world units, zero or more. Zero takes the unit's own sight radius, followed as it changes.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The unit the region follows. A client ignores the message where it does not know the unit.

fields.name: lifetime
fields.note: How long it lasts, in seconds. A client counts it down and removes the region once it reaches zero, so zero or less removes it at once.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The id the client keeps the region under. Zero has the client pick one.

fields.name: does

bits.name: grantSight
bits.note: Set where the region shows the map; where view is 2, a client also sets revealHidden. What else it changes is not recorded.

bits.name: revealHidden
bits.note: What this changes on a client is not recorded.

bits.name: attached
bits.note: Its value has no effect; a server writes zero.

fields.note: What the region does.

fields.name: marker
fields.note: A region sent again with the same value is taken as the one already shown; what else it names is not recorded. A server sends zero.

fields.name: sightFrom
fields.note: A region sent again with the same value is taken as the one already shown; what else it names is not recorded. A server sends zero.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of region it is. Where it is 2, the region belongs to the client clientId names; what other values mean is not recorded.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: Unused; a client reads nothing here.

fields.name: sightRadius
fields.note: How far the region shows the map around it, in world units. Zero takes the unit's own sight radius, or a default where it has none.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The unit the region follows. A client takes the region even where it does not hold the unit.

fields.name: lifetime
fields.note: How long it lasts, in seconds. A client counts it down and removes the region once it reaches zero or less. Whether one that starts at zero or less is kept is not recorded.

fields.name: marker
fields.note: The region's id, which RegionRemoved names; 4294967295 has the client pick one of its own. A region sent again with the same id, kind and radius changes the one held rather than adding another.

fields.name: does
fields.note: What the region does.

bits.name: flag
bits.note: What this changes on a client is not recorded.

bits.name: second
bits.note: A second choice a client keeps with the region; it also sets it itself where kind is 2 and the bit below it is set.

fields.note: Kept with the region as it stands; what it does is not recorded. A server writes zero.
